events.title: CVE-2026-115893 — Wasmtime is a runtime for WebAssembly. Prior to 36.0.19, 48.0.7, and 49.0.4, the Cranelift compiler backend on aarch64 can compile a Wasm br
events.summary: (vendor/severity tags below are heuristic) Wasmtime is a runtime for WebAssembly. Prior to 36.0.19, 48.0.7, and 49.0.4, the Cranelift compiler backend on aarch64 can compile a Wasm br_table instruction with more than approximately 256,000 targets so that it has an incorrect conditional branch target. The branch can then jump to arbitrary other code at a user-controlled offset, allowing a user-controlled Wasm module to escape the sandbox on aarch64 engines using the default Cranelift backend. This issue is fixed in versions 36.0.19, 48.0.7, and 49.0.4.
events.resolution: Two sandbox escape vulnerabilities in Wasmtime's Cranelift compiler backend, CVE-2026-115893 and CVE-2026-115889, were disclosed on 2026-10-23. The first could let a crafted br_table instruction on aarch64 jump to attacker-controlled code, breaking Wasm sandboxing; the second involved bit-packed SSA value indices. The issues were resolved with patches in Wasmtime 36.0.19, 48.0.7, 49.0.4 and 43.0.0 respectively.
